versions.title: Smooth Turns
versions.summary: Q and E now swing the camera round you like a real 3D camera, instead of sliding the picture.
versions.intro: Turning the camera used to spin a flat picture of the world and fade it into the next one, which made it hard to follow. Now the camera really orbits you: the land, the houses and the cliffs turn as solid blocks, trees and props stay standing, and the turn eases in and out before landing exactly on the next view.

sections.title: Improved
items: A real camera turn|Q and E orbit the camera around you to the next quarter turn. Houses, walls and cliffs turn as solid blocks, so you can always tell what you are looking at.
Everything comes along|Trees, flowers and your wanderer stand upright as the view swings, your wanderer turns to face the right way, and lamps and lit windows keep glowing in place.
No jumps|The turn eases in and out and settles exactly on the new view, with no flicker at either end.

versions.title: First Steps
versions.summary: The first version of Isom: a whole continent to wander, dig into and build on.
versions.intro: Isom is a wandering world drawn in isometric pixel art. Every seed makes a whole continent thousands of tiles across, with mountains worn down by rain, rivers that run to the sea, lakes, forests, deserts and snow, and little villages joined by winding roads. Walk anywhere, dig anything and build whatever you like.

sections.title: The world
items: A huge continent|Each seed makes a land 8192 tiles across: mountains, valleys, rivers, lakes and coast.
Thirteen kinds of land|Meadows, forests, taiga, jungle, swamp, desert, badlands, snowy peaks and more, set by rain and warmth.
Villages and roads|Little towns with houses and farms, joined by roads and bridges, plus old ruins to find.

sections.title: Exploring
items: Day, night and weather|Sunrises, starry nights, rain, storms, snow and fog that roll across the land.
Turn the camera|Q and E swing the view round a quarter turn, and turning back puts it just as it was.
Map and minimap|M opens the whole continent, with every village named.

sections.title: Building
items: Dig and place|Take the land apart block by block and build anything, with an outline showing exactly where each block goes.
See inside|Roofs and upper floors fade away when you step indoors, so building rooms and floors is easy.
Your worlds are saved|Every world keeps what you built, and updates never touch it.
